title: Tower living quarters
content: Tower apartments with food courts, my dream looked just like this AI image I made, but it was all enclosed (indoors) instead of open. Had spiraling walkways that you could walk down the tower, there were different food courts on every level, but you lived here (it was an apartment building type whatever it was, not just a business) There was a level that was also an airport and you could catch flights of gig went to that level, but the rest was just basic living you didn’t have to go anywhere.
